clips.title: The story
paras: At Sludge Fen, the Ignition Key is held by Supervisor Lugwizzle at the Venture Company drilling operation. Wizzlecrank needs it to unlock an advanced shredder's movement column and activate its controls.

Sputtervalve of Ratchet sent an operative to steal a Venture Company shredder from Sludge Fen, but the plan stalled. The undercover pilot, Wizzlecrank, climbed into the cockpit and found the movement column locked. He pretended the machine had mechanical trouble so the foremen would not grow suspicious while he waited for someone to fetch the Ignition Key. Supervisor Lugwizzle keeps the key high atop the central oil derrick, where access to the shredder's arm, speed, and rotation controls is held.
